title: Nova Spectral AI Raises ₹21.2 Cr To Build Indigenous Infrared Sensor Chips
script:
Nova Spectral AI just raised twenty-one point two crore rupees for indigenous infrared sensor chips.
Shastra VC led this seed round to help build specialized sensor hardware in India.
The Bengaluru startup is now scaling its research and local manufacturing capabilities.
Founders Anish Priyadarshi and Sanjeev Kumar are tackling critical gaps in semiconductor supply chains.
These infrared sensors are essential for defense and various industrial monitoring applications.
Would you rely on domestically produced hardware for your high-tech gear?
